run.name: Dycom Industries Inc
run.sector: Water, Sewer, Pipeline, Comm & Power Line Construction
run.title: CP-OS host session (DY)
run.summary: Credit quality is sound but not low-risk: scale, recurring carrier work and 1,086.5 million of liquidity offset elevated post-acquisition leverage of 2.96x gross, high customer concentration and an unverified pro forma earnings base. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is DYCOM INDUSTRIES INC.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Notional debt 2,842.7 including finance leases 2.7 (Q2 deck page:4; 10-Q Q2 FY27 page:18) over constructed LTM Adjusted EBITDA 959.8; cash 340.080 (10-Q Q2 FY27 page:2). 53 weeks. Not pro forma for Power Solutions before December 23, 2025 or National Technology Integrators before July 2, 2026. Not a covenant ratio.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Constructed LTM Adjusted EBITDA 959.8 over constructed LTM cash paid for interest 86.434 (62.302 less 27.910 plus 52.042; 10-K page:85, 10-Q Q2 FY27 page:5). Run-rate interest of about 148.9 (rate times balances, before fees) gives about 6.45x; interest expense, net for the LTM of 110.409 gives 8.69x.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash 340.080 (10-Q Q2 FY27 page:2). Availability 746.4 (10-Q Q2 FY27 page:21); the deck liquidity of 1,086.5 (Q2 deck page:4) equals the two amounts. The availability computation nets cash against funded debt and is not printed.

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant terms, ownership and pro forma acquired earnings are not available, so leverage and covenant headroom cannot be confirmed on the lenders' own basis.

CP-1 main limitation: Covenant EBITDA is not disclosed, and the last-twelve-month base includes the acquired Building Systems businesses only from their acquisition dates, so ratios are not pro forma.
